name: Advisor Profile AI Executive Summary v1
description: AI-generated insight bullets at the top of every advisor's Public Profile page. Nightly batch (Lambda + Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6) generates per-advisor S3 artifact from a fixed 6-slot template library (leaderboard rank delta, top NNA mover, biggest position gain/loss, fee change, cohort drift). LLM only fills prose; structure + icons + severity are templated for predictability + auditability. JWT scoping inherited from existing auth-validator-edge + shared-advisor-router. SummaryCard panel renamed 'Executive Summary' with bullets above existing Hero/AUA/flows/fee tiles. v2 = admin text-to-SQL (deferred); v3 = outbound Salesforce push (deferred).
phase: Phase 0 — PRD complete, COO decomposition pending. 7 TOs scoped in PRD §7: TO 1 ds-template-library-and-trigger-eval, TO 2 ds-llm-prose-generator, TO 3 ae-anthropic-sdk-layer, TO 4 dt-generator-lambda-terraform, TO 5 ds-leaderboard-prior-week-rotation, TO 6 de-summary-card-rebrand-and-bullets, TO 7 dt-eventbridge-wiring-and-deploy. Cross-domain coordination matrix in PRD §7. New micro-pipeline `exec-summary` with own Terraform module + tag series.
blocking: COO TO authoring against PRD compiler-mandate matrix. AE 0.6 must confirm gold-chain-complete EventBridge signal format before TO 7 dispatches. comp-pii audit on platinum/advisors/* + platinum/leaderboards/* must run at TO 1 Phase 1 (hard gate before LLM prompt construction).
